test_gtn_equal: test two gtn Graph objects for structural equality including nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test whether two gtn Graph objects are structurally isomorphic regardless of node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt_savetxt: test loading and saving gtn Graph objects to and from plain text format files
test_gtn_load_save: test loading and saving gtn Graph objects to and from binary format files
test_gtn_graph_construction: test creating gtn Graph objects with start nodes, accept nodes, and weighted arcs
